title: The map with a hole in it
prose: When the fire is low they unroll a map drawn on bark, and one of them traces your road on it for you with a stick. The middle of it is burned through, a hole the size of a hand. Somebody dropped it in a fire, she says. We have been walking round the edge of it for two seasons, filling it in.

choices.label: Ask what was in the middle
choices.line: Nobody knows, she says. That is why we are walking. She rolls the map up and says it is a better reason than most.

choices.label: Tell them what you have seen
choices.line: You tell them what you have walked through, and she draws a stream into the hole, small and careful, in the right place.

notes: A fireside story for a night slept beside a camp of adventurers (Roads and Hands, phase 5). Shared by every map, as the owner's four camp kinds are. Drafted for the owner to rewrite or approve.
